title: Keep away from fire starters and hot items
objective: Prevent a learner from handling a common ignition or burn hazard.
ordered_actions: Do not touch the item.
Step away.
Tell a teacher or guardian where it is.
prohibited_actions: Do not play with matches, lighters, candles, a stove, chemicals, fuel, or fire.
Do not test whether an item is hot.
adult_handoff: A responsible adult makes the item safe.
rationale: The BFP child manual explicitly teaches children to stay away from these hazards.
safe_default: Step away and tell an adult.

en-PH.short: Do not touch it—tell an adult.
en-PH.instruction: Step away from matches, lighters, candles, stoves, fuel, chemicals, and fire.

fil-PH.instruction: Lumayo sa posporo, lighter, kandila, kalan, gasolina, kemikal, at apoy.

taglish-PH.short: Do not touch it—tell an adult.
taglish-PH.instruction: Step away from matches, lighters, candles, stoves, fuel, chemicals, at fire.

title: Know the fire exit and meeting point
objective: Prepare the learner to leave quickly and gather safely.
ordered_actions: Know two approved ways out when available.
Know the outdoor meeting or assembly point.
Practise the route with a teacher or guardian.
Keep exits clear.
prohibited_actions: Do not create a route through a locked, damaged, or unapproved area.
adult_handoff: The school or guardian approves and maintains the route.
rationale: A rehearsed route and meeting point support fast evacuation and headcount.
safe_default: Ask the teacher or guardian to show the approved exit and meeting point.

en-PH.short: Know your exit and meeting point.
en-PH.instruction: Practise the approved route with an adult and keep the way out clear.

fil-PH.short: Alamin ang labasan at meeting point.
fil-PH.instruction: Sanayin ang tamang ruta kasama ang nakatatanda at panatilihing walang harang ang daan palabas.

taglish-PH.short: Know your exit and meeting point.
taglish-PH.instruction: Practise the approved route with an adult at keep the way out clear.

title: Recognize an outdoor fire boundary
objective: Teach the conservative boundary of never approaching outdoor flame or smoke.
ordered_actions: Identify the scenario-approved safe zone.
Identify the nearest responsible adult or alarm point.
Keep away from any flame or smoke.
prohibited_actions: Do not approach, investigate, touch, or try to put out an outdoor fire.
adult_handoff: BFP and the local DRRMO must approve the outdoor scenario and route.
rationale: The current local corpus lacks a complete child-specific vegetation or outdoor-fire protocol.
safe_default: Keep away from flame and smoke and tell an adult.

en-PH.short: Keep away from flame and smoke.
en-PH.instruction: Know the approved safe zone and tell a responsible adult if you see an outdoor fire.

fil-PH.instruction: Alamin ang itinakdang safe zone at magsabi sa nakatatanda kapag may nakitang sunog sa labas.

taglish-PH.short: Keep away from flame and smoke.
taglish-PH.instruction: Know the approved safe zone at tell a responsible adult kapag may outdoor fire.

review_notes: Conservative placeholder only; requires BFP and local DRRMO outdoor-fire protocol.

title: Alert and evacuate immediately
objective: Start immediate life-safety evacuation without assigning suppression to the child.
ordered_actions: Alert the nearest adult or teacher and activate an accessible alarm if safe.
Use the approved safe exit immediately.
Go to the meeting or assembly point.
prohibited_actions: Do not stop to fight the fire.
Do not collect belongings or look for pets.
Do not delay to make a call while still in danger.
adult_handoff: An adult or responder makes the emergency call and handles suppression unless the deployment has a separately approved safe call step.
rationale: For a Grade 4 learner evacuation outranks suppression or possessions.
safe_default: Alert and leave by the approved safe exit.

en-PH.short: Alert an adult and evacuate now.
en-PH.instruction: Use the approved safe exit and go straight to the meeting point. Leave belongings behind.

fil-PH.short: Magbabala sa nakatatanda at lumikas ngayon.
fil-PH.instruction: Gamitin ang tamang ligtas na labasan at dumiretso sa meeting point. Iwan ang mga gamit.

taglish-PH.short: Alert an adult and evacuate now.
taglish-PH.instruction: Use the approved safe exit at dumiretso sa meeting point. Leave your belongings.

title: Use stairs not an elevator in fire
objective: Keep the learner off an elevator during a fire.
ordered_actions: Follow the approved exit signs or teacher.
Use the safe stair route.
Continue to the outdoor meeting point.
prohibited_actions: Do not use an elevator.
Do not use a stair route blocked by smoke or fire.
adult_handoff: A teacher or responder redirects the group if the normal stair route is unsafe.
rationale: Fire evacuation guidance consistently directs people to stairs rather than elevators.
safe_default: Use only the scenario-approved safe stair route.

en-PH.short: Use the safe stairs, not the elevator.
en-PH.instruction: Follow the approved exit route to the meeting point and do not enter a route blocked by smoke or fire.

fil-PH.short: Gamitin ang ligtas na hagdan, hindi elevator.
fil-PH.instruction: Sundin ang tamang exit route papunta sa meeting point at huwag pumasok sa daang may usok o apoy.

taglish-PH.short: Use the safe stairs, not the elevator.
taglish-PH.instruction: Follow the approved exit route to the meeting point at huwag pumasok sa route na blocked ng smoke o fire.

title: Do not open a hot or smoky door
objective: Block a route that the trusted VR state marks unsafe.
ordered_actions: Do not open the door.
Use the approved alternate exit if it is safe.
If no safe exit exists use the trapped-person protocol.
prohibited_actions: Do not touch or open the marked hot door.
Do not enter smoke or flame.
adult_handoff: A teacher or responder determines the alternate route.
rationale: CALM should use a trusted door state rather than asking a child to test a possibly dangerous surface.
safe_default: Keep the door closed and use the approved alternate or trapped protocol.

en-PH.instruction: Use the approved alternate exit if it is safe. If there is no safe exit, signal for help.

fil-PH.instruction: Gamitin ang tamang alternatibong labasan kung ligtas. Kung walang ligtas na labasan, humingi ng tulong.

taglish-PH.instruction: Use the approved alternate exit kung safe. Kung walang safe exit, signal for help.

review_notes: Uses trusted VR door state instead of instructing a child to touch-test a real door.

title: Stay low and crawl under smoke
objective: Move the learner through the approved escape route below smoke.
ordered_actions: Get low.
Crawl along the approved safe route.
Keep moving to the exit and meeting point.
prohibited_actions: Do not stand in the smoke.
Do not delay to find or wet a cloth.
Do not enter a route blocked by fire.
adult_handoff: A teacher or responder selects another route if the current one is blocked.
rationale: Low movement is an escape action; a damp cloth must not be presented as smoke protection.
safe_default: Stay low and follow the approved safe route out.

en-PH.short: Get low and crawl to the safe exit.
en-PH.instruction: Follow the approved route without stopping to find a cloth, then go to the meeting point.

fil-PH.short: Yumuko at gumapang papunta sa ligtas na labasan.
fil-PH.instruction: Sundin ang tamang ruta nang hindi humihinto para humanap ng tela, saka pumunta sa meeting point.

taglish-PH.short: Get low and crawl to the safe exit.
taglish-PH.instruction: Follow the approved route without stopping para humanap ng cloth, then go to the meeting point.

title: Stop Drop and Roll for burning clothes
objective: Extinguish flame on the learner's clothing without running.
ordered_actions: Stop.
Drop to the ground.
Cover the face with the hands if possible.
Roll over and over until the flame is out.
Call for adult help.
prohibited_actions: Do not run.
Do not continue normal evacuation while clothing is burning.
adult_handoff: A teacher, guardian, or responder checks the learner and obtains care.
rationale: This self-protective action requires exact immediate wording.
safe_default: Stop, drop, cover the face, and roll.

en-PH.short: Stop, drop, cover your face, and roll.
en-PH.instruction: Keep rolling until the flame is out, then call for adult help.

fil-PH.short: Huminto, dumapa, takpan ang mukha, at gumulong.
fil-PH.instruction: Magpagulong-gulong hanggang mawala ang apoy, saka humingi ng tulong sa nakatatanda.

taglish-PH.short: Stop, drop, cover your face, and roll.
taglish-PH.instruction: Keep rolling hanggang mawala ang flame, then call an adult for help.

title: Signal for help when trapped
objective: Keep the learner visible and connected to rescuers without entering fire.
ordered_actions: Stay in the safest available space away from smoke and flame.
Keep the barrier between you and the fire closed if already closed.
Call out, make noise, or signal at a safe window.
Tell a responder your location if communication is available.
prohibited_actions: Do not hide in a closet or under furniture.
Do not jump from a window.
Do not open a hot or smoky door.
rationale: The learner needs an explicit no-hide and no-jump fallback when evacuation is impossible.
safe_default: Stay visible, keep away from smoke and flame, and signal for help.

en-PH.short: Do not hide or jump—signal for help.
en-PH.instruction: Stay in the safest available space, keep the barrier closed, and call out or signal at a safe window.

fil-PH.short: Huwag magtago o tumalon—humingi ng tulong.
fil-PH.instruction: Manatili sa pinakaligtas na lugar, panatilihing sarado ang harang, at sumigaw o magsenyas sa ligtas na bintana.

taglish-PH.short: Do not hide or jump—signal for help.
taglish-PH.instruction: Stay sa safest available space, keep the barrier closed, at call out or signal sa safe window.

title: Do not fight the fire
objective: Prevent a Grade 4 learner from delaying escape or attempting suppression.
ordered_actions: Move away from the fire.
Alert an adult or alarm if safely reachable.
Use the approved safe exit or safe zone.
prohibited_actions: Do not use an extinguisher, water, cloth, lid, sand, hose, or any other item to fight the fire.
Do not touch LPG, gas, electricity, or appliances.
adult_handoff: A trained adult or firefighter handles suppression and utilities.
rationale: Source manuals contain conflicting supervised-extinguisher lessons; CALM uses the conservative learner boundary.

en-PH.short: Do not fight the fire—move away.
en-PH.instruction: Alert an adult and use the approved safe exit or safe zone. Firefighters handle the fire.

fil-PH.instruction: Magbabala sa nakatatanda at gamitin ang tamang ligtas na labasan o safe zone. Bumbero ang hahawak sa apoy.

taglish-PH.short: Do not fight the fire—move away.
taglish-PH.instruction: Alert an adult and use the approved safe exit or safe zone. Firefighters ang hahawak sa fire.

title: Move away from an outdoor fire
objective: Move the learner to the scenario-approved outdoor safe zone.
ordered_actions: Turn away from the fire and smoke.
Follow the trusted VR route to the approved safe zone.
Alert a responsible adult.
Remain there for instructions.
prohibited_actions: Do not approach, investigate, record, rescue, or fight the fire.
Do not choose a route through smoke.
adult_handoff: BFP and the local DRRMO approve the exact route and response.
rationale: This conservative placeholder closes a dangerous gap but needs specialist local validation.
safe_default: Move away from fire and smoke to the approved safe zone.

en-PH.short: Move away from the fire and smoke.
en-PH.instruction: Follow the approved safe route, alert an adult, and stay in the safe zone.

fil-PH.instruction: Sundin ang itinakdang ligtas na ruta, magsabi sa nakatatanda, at manatili sa safe zone.

taglish-PH.short: Move away from the fire and smoke.
taglish-PH.instruction: Follow the approved safe route, alert an adult, at stay sa safe zone.

review_notes: Not eligible for runtime until BFP and local DRRMO approve the outdoor-fire scenario.

title: Once outside stay outside
ordered_actions: Stay at the meeting, assembly, or safe point.
Tell an adult if someone or something is still inside.
Wait for firefighter or authority clearance.
prohibited_actions: Do not go back for a person, pet, phone, bag, or any belonging.
Do not enter to check whether the fire is out.
adult_handoff: Firefighters handle rescue, suppression, and re-entry clearance.
rationale: Re-entry exposes the learner to heat, smoke, collapse, and renewed fire.
safe_default: Remain outside at the safe point.

en-PH.instruction: Stay at the safe point, tell an adult who or what is inside, and wait for firefighter clearance.

fil-PH.short: Kapag nakalabas na, manatili sa labas.
fil-PH.instruction: Manatili sa safe point, sabihin sa nakatatanda kung sino o ano ang nasa loob, at hintayin ang pahintulot ng bumbero.

taglish-PH.instruction: Stay at the safe point, tell an adult kung sino o ano ang nasa loob, at wait for firefighter clearance.

title: Stay at the meeting point for headcount
objective: Keep the learner available for family or school accounting.
ordered_actions: Go to the assigned meeting or assembly point.
Stay with the family or class.
Answer the headcount.
Report a missing person to the adult in charge.
prohibited_actions: Do not leave the group or return inside.
Do not search for a missing person.
adult_handoff: The guardian or school staff performs headcount and reports missing people to responders.
rationale: A fixed gathering point lets adults identify who may need help.
safe_default: Stay with the assigned group at the safe point.

en-PH.instruction: Stay with your family or class for headcount and tell the adult in charge if someone is missing.

fil-PH.instruction: Manatili kasama ang pamilya o klase para sa bilang at sabihin sa nakatatanda kung may nawawala.

taglish-PH.instruction: Stay with your family or class for headcount at tell the adult in charge kung may missing.

PDF pages 418-420 staff-led evacuation and headcount

title: Keep distance after an outdoor fire
objective: Prevent approach to a burn area that may remain hot or unstable.
ordered_actions: Remain at the approved safe zone.
Tell an adult about smoke, hot areas, or missing people.
Wait for responder clearance.
prohibited_actions: Do not touch ash, debris, wires, containers, or burned objects.
Do not perform cleanup or rescue.
adult_handoff: Responders assess and clear the area.
rationale: The outdoor-fire after-phase lacks a child-specific national source and requires local approval.
safe_default: Keep your distance and wait for responders.

en-PH.short: Keep away from the burned area.
en-PH.instruction: Stay in the approved safe zone, report hazards to an adult, and wait for responder clearance.

fil-PH.instruction: Manatili sa itinakdang safe zone, ireport ang panganib sa nakatatanda, at hintayin ang pahintulot ng responder.

taglish-PH.short: Keep away from the burned area.
taglish-PH.instruction: Stay sa approved safe zone, report hazards to an adult, at wait for responder clearance.

review_notes: Requires BFP and local DRRMO validation before runtime.

title: Report a burn or injury
objective: Escalate a possible injury without giving unapproved medical treatment.
ordered_actions: Tell a teacher, guardian, or responder immediately.
State what hurts or what happened.
Stay in the safe area and follow the trained adult.
prohibited_actions: Do not diagnose the injury.
Do not apply medicine, cream, ice, or other treatment unless a trained adult directs it.
adult_handoff: A trained adult or responder assesses and treats the learner.
rationale: CALM should recognize the need for help but not act as a medical service.

en-PH.short: Tell a trained adult about the injury.
en-PH.instruction: Say what happened and stay in the safe area. Do not put medicine, cream, or ice on it by yourself.

fil-PH.short: Sabihin agad sa nakatatandang may pagsasanay ang pinsala.
fil-PH.instruction: Sabihin ang nangyari at manatili sa safe area. Huwag maglagay ng gamot, cream, o yelo nang mag-isa.

taglish-PH.short: Tell a trained adult about the injury.
taglish-PH.instruction: Say what happened and stay sa safe area. Huwag maglagay ng medicine, cream, or ice by yourself.

source_claims.locator: PDF pages 211-213 adult and firefighter handoff
